description: Source code implementing cryptographic random number generation functions for BIGNUMs in OpenSSL's BoringSSL, including functions for generating random big numbers within specified ranges and with specific properties.

methods.name: BN_rand
methods.description: Generates a random BIGNUM with specified bit length and properties.

methods.name: BN_pseudo_rand
methods.description: Pseudo-random number generator for BIGNUMs, identical to BN_rand in this implementation.

methods.name: BN_rand_range
methods.description: Generates a random BIGNUM within a specified range.

methods.name: BN_rand_range_ex
methods.description: Generates a random BIGNUM within a range specified by a minimum and exclusive maximum.

methods.name: bn_rand_secret_range
methods.description: Generates a secret random number within a range, with additional constant-time range check.

methods.name: bn_rand_range_words
methods.description: Core function implementing range-based random number generation with retries.
